Client/Binders/DynamicHideClient.luau.description: Dynamic Hide Client provides the class/model implementation used by the Hide package. Public entry points include `DynamicHideClient.new`.

Client/Binders/HideClient.luau.description: See [Binder] for usage. Public entry points include `HideClient.new`, `HideClient.Destroy`.

Client/HideServiceClient.luau.description: Hide Service Client provides the service implementation used by the Hide package. Public entry points include `HideServiceClient.Init`.

Shared/DynamicHideBase.luau.description: Dynamic Hide Base provides the class/model implementation used by the Hide package. Public entry points include `DynamicHideBase.new`.

Shared/HideUtils.luau.description: Utility involving the [Hide] binder. Public entry points include `HideUtils.isHidden`, `HideUtils.hasLocalTransparencyModifier`, `HideUtils.hasTransparency`.
